newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean industrial output up 4.5 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Chilean industrial output up 4.5 pct in May.

text.p: Industrial production in Chile rose 4.5 percent in May over the same month last year, but physical industrial sales slipped 3.1 percent in the same month, the National Statistics Institute reported.
The new figures brought the rise in industrial production in the first five months of the year to 1.0 percent, and the rise in industrial sales to 3.1 percent, said the institute.
Industrial production rose 3.3 percent in April over April 1996.
The biggest production increases in May were in printing and publishing, up 27.7 percent; industrial chemical substances, up 26.5 percent; and chemical products, up 19.9 percent.
